prompt: drum n bass, dufry, fred again
title: Cathedral of Wet Air
description: A cavernous noise-sculpted pad: resonant white noise breathing under a faint sustained voice, so the seasick vibrato has something to bite. A slow saw filter journey climbs from sub-bass murk to airy hiss while perlin pan-scatter and a triangle pan LFO drift the wash across a wide cavern of room reverb. Over 32 cycles the resonance swells, the vibrato wobbles in primes, and the filter floor rises and falls so the bed never settles.
code:
setcpm(174/4)
stack(
  note("c2").s("white*2")
    .noise(0.85)
    .lpf(saw.slow(32).range(180, 5200))
    .resonance(sine.slow(23).range(10, 18))
    .bpf(perlin.slow(29).range(400, 2600))
    .ftype("ladder")
    .vib("<3 5 7>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.5, 0.95))
    .attack(2.2).release(3.5).sustain(0.9)
    .pan(tri.slow(11).range(0.15, 0.85))
    .off(0.013, x => x.pan(perlin.slow(7)).gain(0.4).hpf(900))
    .gain(0.85)
    .room(sine.slow(16).range(0.55, 0.92)).roomsize(7)
    .orbit(2),
  note("<c3 ab2 eb3 g2>/8").s("sawtooth")
    .vib("<3 5 7>/8").vibmod(0.9)
    .lpf(saw.slow(32).range(260, 1400))
    .resonance(6)
    .attack(3).release(4).sustain(0.8)
    .pan(tri.slow(13).range(0.7, 0.3))
    .gain(0.34)
    .room(0.8).roomsize(6)
    .orbit(2)
)
